forensic_summary.trigger: Catastrophic 100% failure rate (7/7 units) in EVT2 Thermal Stress testing (65°C/-20°C) manifesting as 'Plastic Cap Floating', compounded by a 0.3mm tooling depth mismatch causing 'Gap between Elvis cap and front housing' and 'Cheep sound' acoustic defects.
forensic_summary.intervention: The Architect mandated a 'Stop Ship' on PSA tape, forcing a transition to liquid structural glue. Concurrently directed a tooling modification to replace Gloss finish with 'VDI-15' to resolve paint delamination and added internal ribs to dampen acoustic hollowness (SAT-281).
forensic_summary.result: Glued units passed Crush, Drop, and Environmental tests, securing the launch configuration.

war_stories.label: Plastic Cap Floating
war_stories.description: Resolved 100% EVT2 failure rate (7/7) by replacing PSA tape with liquid structural glue to bridge 0.3mm gap.

war_stories.label: Acoustic 'Cheep' Sound
war_stories.description: Eliminated high-frequency noise via UV-verified lubrication and internal structural ribbing.

war_stories.label: Paint Delamination
war_stories.description: Mandated tooling change from Gloss to VDI-15 to resolve cosmetic paint adhesion failures.

war_stories.label: Yellowing Gate
war_stories.description: Enforced strict spectrophotometer limits to catch UV coating degradation, driving resin study.

war_stories.label: Cost Engineering
war_stories.description: Optimized Gen 2 mechanical BOM to hit $49 margin on $79 MSRP.
